text:
Amelia Park: Quick sync — sketching a proposal for targeted release slices + guardrails for the geo-routing feature flags. Need ops/eng/pm input before I turn this into a launch doc.

Raj Patel: Can you paste the sketch? especially canary sizes per region.

Amelia Park: Sketch: 
```
- Phase 0 (internal): 1% traffic, single region (us-west), smoke tests only
- Phase 1 (canary): 5% traffic, us-west + eu-west, 72h monitoring window
- Phase 2 (gradual ramp): +10%/day until 50% across selected regions
- A/B experiment: eu-west only, 50/50 split for new routing policy, 7d
```
Guardrails (proposed):
- latency P95 delta < 20ms vs baseline
- error rate delta < 0.5% absolute
- cost per 1k tokens delta < 15%
Rollback triggers: any guardrail breached for 2 consecutive 15m windows OR a customer-visible SLA breach (>=1 major customer impacted).

Sophia Li: Add automatic fallback to smaller model variant when cost/throughput spikes, and a “force local region” safety that pins routing to same region if inter-region RTT > 200ms. Also capture generation-quality checks in the canary.

Ben Torres: For flags, use schema: {boolean enabled, rollout_percentage, region_allowlist, escape_hatch}. Escape hatch should be a single infra API call that disables globally within <30s. We should include a read-only view in Console for current rollout % per region.

jenkins-bot: deploy canary tag=geo-flag-canary at 1801124000: deployment succeeded to us-west, eu-west.

Marta Rivas: Customer request: AcmeCorp asked for ap-southeast inclusion in canary. They want opt-in. My suggestion: include ap-southeast but start at 1% and keep 72h window (lower initial % because of network/backhaul risks). Need compliance check for AP region.

Raj Patel: Operational notes: ensure tracing hooks are 100% sampled for canary traffic and routed to a dedicated queue "canary-traces" for quick debugging. Add a short-term retention policy (14d) for these traces. Evals team should run prompt-set v3 against canary outputs to detect quality regressions.

Amelia Park: Decision items to confirm:
1) Include ap-southeast opt-in at 1% for specific customers (Marta to coordinate)
2) Run A/B in eu-west as proposed (7d)
3) Implement model-fallback + force-local-region behaviors before open canary
4) Rollback automation: if 2 triggers hit, auto-disable flag + open incident page and notify on-call
Owners: Raj (infra/tracing), Sophia (runtime/fallback), Ben (flags + console), Marta (customer coordination). Timeline: internal smoke now, canary Wed 03:00 UTC.

Ben Torres: I'll add flag schema + escape hatch PR today (will link).

Sophia Li: Runtime changes: model-fallback should be able to swap to smaller variant in ~30s and maintain KV cache compatibility. I'll test in staging tomorrow.

Amelia Park: I'll write the launch doc + checklist and add these items. @Raj please confirm tracing hooks by EOD. :thumbsup:

Raj Patel: Confirmed — will add sampling, queue, and short retention by EOD.

Marta Rivas: I'll get AcmeCorp opt-in and run compliance check for ap-southeast, update thread when done.

Amelia Park: Thanks all — will open the launch doc and assign tasks. Short check: anyone foresee major blockers?

Sophia Li: One: KV cache migration risk if we swap model families. We'll need a migration plan or graceful degrade option where local cache warms for 1-2 minutes.

Ben Torres: Noted. Flag schema will include a "grace_period_sec" field to hold traffic on old model for short period after switch.

Amelia Park: Perfect. I'll include that in the doc. Closing — action items assigned. :white_check_mark:
